description: Bike Facilities is a dataset listed in City of Fort Collins open data portal (opendata.fcgov.com), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Fort Collins. THIS SITE WILL BE DISCONTINUED ON JUNE 30, 2026. Visit the home page at for details. Coverage: Fort Collins. The table has 28 columns. The portal shows 2026-03-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-opendata-fcgov-com-portal.
